question: Point out the FALSE response in the elaboration of suppositories:

options.opa: The hydrophilic excipients do not present problems of preservation at elevated temperatures.
options.opb: The glycerin excipients usually contain 20% glycerin and 80% gelatin.
options.opc: The irritant power of the polyethylene glycols used can be reduced with the addition of 20% water to the dough.
options.opd: Suppositories made with polyethylene glycol can be fragile especially when they have incorporated water.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "The hydrophilic excipients do not present problems of preservation at elevated temperatures" -> FALSE -> 80% CHAIN: "The glycerin excipients usually contain 20% glycerin and 80% gelatin" -> TRUE -> 95% CHAIN: "The irritant power of the polyethylene glycols used can be reduced with the addition of 20% water to the dough" -> TRUE -> 90% CHAIN: "Suppositories made with polyethylene glycol can be fragile especially when they have incorporated water" -> TRUE -> 80%
analysis: The false response in the elaboration of suppositories is option b. Glycerin excipients do not usually contain 20% glycerin and 80% gelatin.
